description: Search ~1,300 biomedical ontologies for a term and get back the matching classes with their preferred label, synonyms, definition, ontology and permanent class IRI. AUTHORITATIVE for mapping free text to a coded clinical concept (NCIT, SNOMEDCT, LOINC, RXNORM, MESH, HPO, ICD10CM) — these are the curated terminologies themselves, not a description of them. Restrict with `ontologies` when you know which vocabulary you want.

_apiKey.description: Your own BioPortal API key (free, https://bioportal.bioontology.org/accounts/new). Optional — without one the call uses a shared key that NCBO rate-limits across all of its users.

ontologies.description: Comma-separated ontology acronyms to restrict to (e.g. "NCIT,DOID,SNOMEDCT")

require_definitions.description: Only return classes that carry a definition

name: bioportal_search
title: Bioportal Search
